lede: One topic, and only one, surfaced on two feeds at once: Iga Swiatek's China Open match against Donna Vekic, trending on Google and trading on Polymarket, where the market gives Vekic roughly an 18 percent chance against a heavily favored Swiatek on about $847K in volume. Everywhere else the day pulled apart. Wikipedia's most-read article was Christa Pike at 461,568 views, about 1.2 times the runner-up, and nothing in the snapshot tied the feeds together.
